description: Skill authoring task: embed the Engram RAG block. Adapter must surface the convention failure so the patcher is invoked with the canonical topic key.
task_text: Update an OpenCode skill under `~/.config/opencode/skills/<agent>/SKILL.md`. The YAML frontmatter is present and the file is on disk, so the patcher must insert the Engram RAG block in place.
expected_applied_rules: OpenCode skill shipped without a valid YAML frontmatter or with a hand-written Engram RAG block using a forbidden v1 topic alias.
